roles/chronicle.admin.title: Chronicle API Admin
roles/chronicle.admin.desc: Full access to the Chronicle API services, including global settings.

roles/chronicle.editor.title: Chronicle API Editor
roles/chronicle.editor.desc: Modify Access to Chronicle API resources.

roles/chronicle.limitedViewer.title: Chronicle API Limited Viewer
roles/chronicle.limitedViewer.desc: Grants read-only access to Chronicle API resources, excluding Rules and Retrohunts.

roles/chronicle.orgServiceAgent.title: Chronicle Organization Service Agent
roles/chronicle.orgServiceAgent.desc: Gives Secops Service Agent access to organization level resources like CAI.

roles/chronicle.serviceAgent.title: Chronicle Service Agent
roles/chronicle.serviceAgent.desc: Grants Chronicle global data access to customer project

roles/chronicle.soarAdmin.title: Chronicle SOAR Admin
roles/chronicle.soarAdmin.desc: Grants admin access to Chronicle SOAR.

roles/chronicle.soarServiceAgent.title: Chronicle SOAR Service Agent
roles/chronicle.soarServiceAgent.desc: Gives Chronicle SOAR the ability to perform remediation on Cloud Platform resources.

roles/chronicle.soarThreatManager.title: Chronicle SOAR Threat Manager
roles/chronicle.soarThreatManager.desc: Grants threat manager access to Chronicle SOAR.

roles/chronicle.soarVulnerabilityManager.title: Chronicle SOAR Vulnerability Manager
roles/chronicle.soarVulnerabilityManager.desc: Grants vulnerability manager access to Chronicle SOAR.

roles/chronicle.viewer.title: Chronicle API Viewer
roles/chronicle.viewer.desc: Read-only access to the Chronicle API resources.
